name: GN — scatter instances sur grille
description: Crée un Geometry Node Tree (MeshGrid → Distribute RANDOM → Instance IcoSphere → Realize), l’assigne à GN_Host, règle Density / Instance Scale. Validé Blender 4.0.2. Lis skill://geometry-nodes.

steps.code:
import bpy

DENSITY = {{density}}
INSTANCE_SCALE = {{instance_scale}}
GRID_SIZE = {{grid_size}}

def build(name='GN_ScatterDemo'):
    if name in bpy.data.node_groups:
        bpy.data.node_groups.remove(bpy.data.node_groups[name])
    ng = bpy.data.node_groups.new(name, 'GeometryNodeTree')
    ng.is_modifier = True
    nodes, links = ng.nodes, ng.links
    nodes.clear()
    s_d = ng.interface.new_socket(name='Density', in_out='INPUT', socket_type='NodeSocketFloat')
    s_d.default_value = float(DENSITY)
    s_s = ng.interface.new_socket(name='Instance Scale', in_out='INPUT', socket_type='NodeSocketFloat')
    s_s.default_value = float(INSTANCE_SCALE)
    ng.interface.new_socket(name='Geometry', in_out='INPUT', socket_type='NodeSocketGeometry')
    ng.interface.new_socket(name='Geometry', in_out='OUTPUT', socket_type='NodeSocketGeometry')
    n_in = nodes.new('NodeGroupInput'); n_in.location = (-700, 0)
    n_out = nodes.new('NodeGroupOutput'); n_out.location = (500, 0)
    grid = nodes.new('GeometryNodeMeshGrid'); grid.location = (-450, 150)
    grid.inputs['Size X'].default_value = float(GRID_SIZE)
    grid.inputs['Size Y'].default_value = float(GRID_SIZE)
    grid.inputs['Vertices X'].default_value = 24
    grid.inputs['Vertices Y'].default_value = 24
    dist = nodes.new('GeometryNodeDistributePointsOnFaces'); dist.location = (-200, 0)
    dist.distribute_method = 'RANDOM'
    ico = nodes.new('GeometryNodeMeshIcoSphere'); ico.location = (-200, -220)
    ico.inputs['Radius'].default_value = 1.0
    ico.inputs['Subdivisions'].default_value = 1
    iop = nodes.new('GeometryNodeInstanceOnPoints'); iop.location = (50, 0)
    scale_v = nodes.new('ShaderNodeCombineXYZ'); scale_v.location = (-50, -200)
    realize = nodes.new('GeometryNodeRealizeInstances'); realize.location = (280, 0)
    links.new(grid.outputs['Mesh'], dist.inputs['Mesh'])
    links.new(n_in.outputs['Density'], dist.inputs['Density'])
    links.new(dist.outputs['Points'], iop.inputs['Points'])
    links.new(ico.outputs['Mesh'], iop.inputs['Instance'])
    links.new(n_in.outputs['Instance Scale'], scale_v.inputs['X'])
    links.new(n_in.outputs['Instance Scale'], scale_v.inputs['Y'])
    links.new(n_in.outputs['Instance Scale'], scale_v.inputs['Z'])
    links.new(scale_v.outputs['Vector'], iop.inputs['Scale'])
    links.new(iop.outputs['Instances'], realize.inputs['Geometry'])
    links.new(realize.outputs['Geometry'], n_out.inputs['Geometry'])
    return ng

ng = build()
if 'GN_Host' in bpy.data.objects:
    obj = bpy.data.objects['GN_Host']
else:
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_plane_add(size=1, location=(0, 0, 0))
    obj = bpy.context.active_object
    obj.name = 'GN_Host'
mod = next((m for m in obj.modifiers if m.type == 'NODES'), None)
if mod is None:
    mod = obj.modifiers.new('GeometryNodes', 'NODES')
mod.node_group = ng
for item in ng.interface.items_tree:
    if getattr(item, 'in_out', None) != 'INPUT' or not hasattr(item, 'identifier'):
        continue
    if item.socket_type == 'NodeSocketGeometry':
        continue
    if item.name == 'Density':
        mod[item.identifier] = float(DENSITY)
    elif item.name == 'Instance Scale':
        mod[item.identifier] = float(INSTANCE_SCALE)
bpy.context.view_layer.update()
eval_obj = obj.evaluated_get(bpy.context.evaluated_depsgraph_get())
result = {
    'ok': True,
    'object': obj.name,
    'tree': ng.name,
    'evaluated_verts': len(eval_obj.data.vertices),
    'evaluated_polygons': len(eval_obj.data.polygons),
}
